chunks: We know what the earth consumes of them, for We have the Book that preserves everything.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about the earth consuming the dead and the preserved Book?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Qaf underscores the transition from the physical decay of the body in the earth to its spiritual preservation in the 'Preserved Book' (Kitab Hafiz), often interpreted as the Quran or the record of deeds. It highlights the divine precision in tracking both the material remnants of the deceased and their eternal spiritual accounting, reinforcing the concept of bodily resurrection despite physical dissolution.
